**Classic Lasagna Ingredients** | Category | Typical Items | |----------|---------------| | **Pasta** | • 9–12 sheets of dry lasagna noodles (or fresh if you have them) | | **Meat Sauce** | • 1 lb ground beef
• ½ lb Italian sausage (optional)
• 2 cups crushed tomatoes or passata
• 1 cup tomato sauce
• ¼‑cup chopped onion
• 2 cloves garlic, minced
• 1 tsp dried oregano
• 1 tsp dried basil
• Salt & pepper to taste | | **Bechamel / White Sauce** *(if using)* | • 2 Tbsp butter
• ⅓ cup all‑purpose flour
• 2 cups milk (whole or 2% works best)
• Pinch nutmeg
• Salt & white pepper | | **Cheeses** | • 15 oz ricotta cheese (room temperature)
• ¾ cup grated Parmesan
• 2 cups shredded mozzarella (part-skim or whole-milk)
- Optional: ½ cup shredded provolone or fontina | | **Extras** | • Fresh parsley or basil leaves for garnish
• Olive oil (for sautéing onions/garlic)
• Red pepper flakes (a pinch, if desired) | ### Quick Assembly Steps 1. **Cook Noodles:** Boil pasta until al dente; drain and lay flat on parchment paper so they don’t stick together. 2. **Prepare Meat Sauce:** Sauté onion & garlic → add meats → brown → stir in tomatoes/sauce + herbs → simmer ~20 min. 3. **Make Bechamel (Optional):** Melt butter → whisk in flour → gradually pour milk while stirring → cook till thickened → season. 4. **Layer:** Start with a thin layer of meat sauce at bottom of baking dish → place noodle sheet → dollop ricotta mixture → sprinkle mozzarella → repeat layers ending with mozzarella & Parmesan on top. 5. **Bake:** Cover with foil, bake 25 min @375°F (190°C). Remove foil, bake another 10–15 min until bubbly & golden. Let rest 10 min before serving. Feel free to tweak quantities based on how many servings you want—this recipe makes roughly 8 portions. Enjoy!
